abilities.name: Molten Inferno: Indomitable Flame

_curatorNotes: Coordinated attack, authored 2026-08-18. gcsim dehya/skill.go:111 subscribes skillDmgHook to event.OnEnemyDamage while dehyaFieldKey is up: any damaging hit fires the field's own attack 2 frames later, behind a 150f status ICD. Talent row 'Field DMG' = 108.4% ATK + 1.86% Max HP at level 10.
icdGate 'none' is gcsim's ICDTagNone on skillAttackInfo (skill.go:220) — every field strike applies its full Pyro, which is why Dehya reads as a reliable off-field applier where Albedo does not.

⚠️ gcsim requires the target inside a radius-10 area around the field, a positional claim we have no vocabulary for; and it lets the field hear ITSELF, so gcsim's Dehya ticks every 2.5s with no player input. Ours never fires off its own output.

Indomitable Flame is the cold-open of the skill chain — cast when no field is up. chainStage(skill, 0, window: 12) advances chain to index 1 with 12s window aligned to field duration. Pressing E again within 12s fires Ranging Flame (skill 2).

↻ 2026-08-18: this line used to read 'On-hit coordinated-attack emission is the P3 (Summon.effects[]) gap; flag and migrate when proposal lands.' The proposal LANDED and the migration is done — the coordinated-attack round (docs/coordinated-attacks-round.md) wired `onHit` damage effects hosted on `Summon.effects[]` through one proc registry (`src/lib/sim/procs.ts`), and the Fiery Sanctum's is authored above at summons[0].effects[0] with its own dated note. Kept for provenance: this note WAS the deferral, and the effect beside it is what closed it. ⚠️ What the migration does not carry is recorded on the effect itself, not here — the radius-10 positional gate, and gcsim letting the field hear its own output.
C2 +6s field duration: modelled as durationModifier on the summon. The C2 'next coordinated attack +50% DMG' half is not modelled — single-hit conditional buff isn't expressible.
A1 Gold-Forged Form (interrupt resistance for party in field): not modelled — interrupt resistance is not in our stat set.

[A7] Dropped the coordinated attack's stat scaling from the user caveat (DMG math is out of scope). Note: the prior caveat said 'DEF + HP' scaling, but the skill description scales the coordinated attack on ATK + Max HP — the DEF reference looks like an error worth verifying.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-18 (caveat refresh): STALE — the coordinated-attack round (2026-08-18) authored this mechanic and it was measured firing. Live parse of `Dehya E Diluc N5 x8` gives the Fiery Sanctum window ticks at 80/242/435/628f with four matching Pyro applications. The caveat said the field attacks were not modelled; they are.
abilities.description:
This art of Dehya's own invention changes its method of use depending on the combat situation.

Indomitable Flame
This skill will be unleashed should there be no Fiery Sanctum field created by Dehya herself present at the time.
Deals AoE Pyro DMG, and creates a field known as Fiery Sanctum.

Fiery Sanctum
When an opponent within a Fiery Sanctum field takes DMG, the field will unleash a coordinated attack, dealing AoE Pyro DMG to them based on Dehya's ATK and Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every 2.5s.
Active characters within this field have their resistance to interruption increased, and when such characters take DMG, a portion of that damage will be mitigated and flow into Redmane's Blood. Dehya will then take this DMG over 10s. When the mitigated DMG stored by Redmane's Blood reaches or goes over a certain percentage of Dehya's Max HP, she will stop mitigating DMG in this way.

Only 1 Fiery Sanctum created by Dehya herself can exist at the same time.

abilities.name: Molten Inferno: Ranging Flame
_curatorNotes: Ranging Flame: chainStage(skill, 1) terminal — fires when chain index is 1 (within Indomitable's 12s window). After firing, chain resets and next E (after Indomitable's 20s CD) starts a fresh cycle.

No summons[]: Ranging Flame relocates the existing Fiery Sanctum (inherits remaining duration + 0.4s pickup extension), it doesn't spawn a new one. Authoring summons[] here would render a duplicate field bar on the timeline.
0.4s field-duration extension on pickup is not modelled. C2 +6s extension lives on Indomitable's summon, not here.
cooldown: 0 because gcsim doesn't call SetCD on the recast path; the 20s CD lives on Indomitable. The chain mechanic (window: 12 on stage 0) effectively gates Ranging Flame's availability.
abilities.description:
Ranging Flame
This skill will be unleashed should a Fiery Sanctum field created by Dehya herself already exist.
Dehya will perform a leaping attack, dealing AoE Pyro DMG before recreating a Fiery Sanctum field at her new position.
A Fiery Sanctum field created this way will inherit the remaining duration of the previous field.

Ranging Flame can be used only once throughout a single Fiery Sanctum field's duration.

abilities.name: Leonine Bite
abilities.caveat: During the burst stance, N and E become Pyro punches and kicks. Typing them shows the regular Normal Attack and Skill frames instead — wrong timing for these in-stance attacks.
_curatorNotes: Burst frames are uniform (105 = burstPunch1Hitmark) because gcsim's Frames callback returns a constant value regardless of next action. The actual cancel windows mid-stance depend on the punch/kick state, which is too dynamic to capture as a single FrameMap.

Stance duration 4.1s. Roaring Barrage: pressing N inside stance fires a faster punch (slow hitmark 50f); pressing E inside stance fires the kick (Incineration Drive at frame 46), which exits the stance early. Not modelled — schema can't express in-stance N/E input redirects with their own dynamic timing.
On stance end, Dehya recreates the picked-up Fiery Sanctum (if she retrieved one at burst start). Not modelled — would need a post-stance summon spawn primitive.

[A7] Dropped from the user caveat: the in-stance attacks scale on ATK + Max HP, and Flame-Mane's Fists auto-pulse roughly every 0.5s (DMG/scaling detail out of scope). The reason base normal-attack frames render is that the in-stance N/E redirects (Roaring Barrage punches/kicks) are not authored as separate ability variants.
abilities.description:
Unleashing her burning anger and casting her inconvenient blade aside, Dehya enters the Blazing Lioness state and increases her resistance to interruption.
In this state, Dehya will automatically and continuously unleash the Flame-Mane's Fists, dealing Pyro DMG based on her ATK and Max HP, and when its duration ends, she will unleash an Incineration Drive, dealing AoE Pyro DMG based on her ATK and Max HP.
If a Fiery Sanctum field created by Dehya's own Elemental Skill "Molten Inferno" exists when this ability is unleashed, Dehya will retrieve it, and then create another field once Blazing Lioness's duration expires. This field will take on the retrieved field's duration at the moment of its retrieval.
In this state, Dehya will be unable to cast her Elemental Skill, or perform Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks. "Normal Attack: Sandstorm Assault" and Elemental Skill "Molten Inferno" will be replaced by "Roaring Barrage."

Roaring Barrage
Unleashing Roaring Barrage within 0.4s after each Flame-Mane's Fist strike will increase the speed at which the next Flame-Mane's Fist strike will be triggered.

passives.name: Unstinting Succor
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) 60% Redmane's Blood DMG reduction post-field-pickup (2s ICD, 6s window) — irrelevant for visualization (mitigation isn't on the timeline); (2) Gold-Forged Form post-Indomitable Flame (interrupt resistance for party in field) — not modelled, interrupt resistance not in stat set.
passives.description:
Within 6 seconds after Dehya retrieves the Fiery Sanctum field through Molten Inferno: Ranging Flame or Leonine Bite, she will take 60% less DMG when receiving DMG from Redmane's Blood. This effect can be triggered once every 2s.
Additionally, within 9s after Dehya unleashes Molten Inferno: Indomitable Flame, she will grant all party members the Gold-Forged Form state. This state will further increase a character's resistance to interruption when they are within the Fiery Sanctum field. Gold-Forged Form can be activated once every 18s.

passives.name: Stalwart and True
_curatorNotes: Heal triggers when HP < 40% (with 20s ICD): 20% Max HP burst + 6% per 2s for 10s. Modelled the burst portion as a manual-triggered self-heal; the per-tick HoT (5 ticks of 6%) isn't modelled because we don't have a periodic-heal primitive.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: Stalwart and True — effects[0] (heal 20% hp, self) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `internal/characters/dehya/asc.go:47-76` — `event.OnPlayerHPDrain`, refused unless `CurrentHPRatio() < 0.4`, 20s ICD (`a4ICDKey`), then `0.2 × MaxHP` plus a five-tick `a4DotHeal` at `0.06 × MaxHP` every 2s (`asc.go:78-93`). No action triggers it; it is a pure HP-threshold watcher. the trigger is an HP watcher, not an action — authored as `passive` + `selfHpBelow: 40` on the Noelle-A1 precedent, which resolves null and lists the heal optimistically; the 6%-every-2s-for-10s HoT half (five ticks, `asc.go:78-93`) is still unmodelled, there being no periodic-heal primitive off a summon. ⚠️ Heals draw nothing in the planner, so the only surface that moves is the Team Builder's heal facet — which is a genuine capability and is exactly what `manual` was hiding. ⛔ Do not fold the HoT in as `scaling: 50` (20 + 5×6): that would invent a single instance the game never deals. ⚠️ gcsim files this under `a4()`; the effect carries no `ascension` gate, matching the corpus majority.

⚠️ The 20s ICD is NOT authored: `procCooldown` is meaningless on a `passive` trigger (characterLint B.9), and there is no HP-drop trigger with a reader. The heal is the 20% Max HP burst; the 6%-per-2s-for-10s tail is still unmodelled.
passives.description: When her HP is less than 40%, Dehya will recover 20% of her Max HP and will restore 6% of her Max HP every 2s for the next 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.

constellations.name: An Oath Abiding
_curatorNotes: Per-burst-hit 1.5 energy + 2.5% Max HP heal, 0.2s ICD. Modelled as a manual-triggered single 2.5% heal — the proc cadence and energy generation aren't modelled. C4 conditions added for clarity.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C4 — effects[0] (heal 2.5% hp, self) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `internal/characters/dehya/cons.go:86-108` — `c4CB()` is the `AttackCBFunc` attached to Flame-Mane's Fist (`burst.go:86`) and Incineration Drive (`burst.go:127`), both `AttackTagElementalBurst`: 0.2s ICD, then `AddEnergy 1.5` and a `0.025 × MaxHP` self-heal. both outputs hang off the same burst-hit callback at a 0.2s ICD; our Leonine Bite is authored as a stance with no per-punch hits, so this fires once per burst here where the game fires it on every Flame-Mane's Fist pulse and on the closing Incineration Drive. ⚠️ ⚠️ Under-fires badly (one proc vs ~8 in a 4.1s stance) — harmless today, because neither a heal nor a self-target energy effect draws anything in the planner and the Team Builder reads the capability, not the count. ⛔ The energy effect is self-target, so it is excluded from the TB's facet chips by design (`capMatchesFacet`); it reaches the detail card and the compare row only.

constellations.name: The Burning Claws Cleaving
_curatorNotes: C6 has three mechanics: (1) Q crit rate +10% (per-ability-type CR buff, not authorable cleanly); (2) Q crit dmg +15% per crit hit during stance, max 60% (proc-stacked, not modellable); (3) Stance duration extended by 0.5s per crit hit, max +2s, 0.2s ICD. Removed the prior placeholder buff effects that mis-modelled all three as plain CR/CDmg buffs without proper gating. (3) fits the `durationExtensions[]` primitive (E5, 2026-05-10) on the burst stance: `{ trigger: { type: 'onHit', filter: { abilityName: "Flame-Mane's Fist", isCrit: true } }, delta: 0.5, maxExtensions: 4, procCooldown: 0.2 }`. Authoring blocked on parser dispatching `onHit` events to stance owners; `isCrit` filter is also still aspirational per F2 caveats. Description-only until per-ability CR/CDmg + proc-stack primitives exist.
constellations.description:
The CRIT Rate of Leonine Bite is increased by 10%.
Additionally, after a Flame-Mane's Fist attack hits an opponent and deals CRIT Hits during a single Blazing Lioness state, it will cause the CRIT DMG of Leonine Bite to increase by 15% for the rest of Blazing Lioness's duration and extend that duration by 0.5s. This effect can be triggered every 0.2s. The duration can be extended for a maximum of 2s and CRIT DMG can be increased by a maximum of 60% this way.

notModeled.reason: We don't simulate chance, so two people planning the same rotation always see the same bars — the extra Blazing Lioness time comes from CRIT hits. Its CRIT Rate bonus covers Leonine Bite alone, which we don't draw.
